about_the_game:
This is a tabletop card war game based on the worldview of Cthulhu Mythos.

Players can choose one of the three gods as the controller and get the initial card given by the god.

Basic gameplay:

Each round, you can choose the card to use, and the use of the card is affected by the faith value.

Cards are divided into:

Building cards: Through building cards, you can build buildings belonging to your own camp on the desktop map, and each building has its own unique functions.

Hint cards: Play hint cards to get some special actions.

Role cards: Whether it is the construction and use of buildings, or the participation in hint actions, role cards are required.

Main god skills:

Each god has unique skills, which need to be completed by the player. If completed, you can get rewards, and if failed, you will receive penalties.

Role skills:

Each character can have skills, and different skills will have different passive effects.

Protagonist:

During the game battle, you will unexpectedly meet the protagonist of this desktop world. By completing the protagonist's tasks, you can experience the story that the protagonist has experienced and watch the protagonist grow up.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: IntelCore i3
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: This is a tabletop card war game based on the worldview of Cthulhu Mythos. Players can choose to play one of the three gods and win the game through their own will.
